title: From Unreliable to Usable: Decomposing Failure Modes and Confidence Signals in LLM Entity Extraction - Evidence from Cyber Threat Intelligence
abstract: arXiv:2610.20417v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Audits of large language model (LLM) extraction from full-length documents report severe unreliability, leaving two questions open: what the failures actually consist of, and whether confidence signals can turn unreliable output into usable output. We run a preregistered, fully frozen evaluation of two new-generation low-cost LLMs (DeepSeek-V4-Flash, GLM-5.3-Flash) with a flagship-tier control (GPT-6.1-Sol) on a public corpus of 354 incident campaigns (315 unique reports, 630 model-report evaluations), scoring extraction quality against gold, confidence calibration, and robustness to single-sentence perturbations. Three findings emerge. (1) Unreliability persists across tiers: micro precision is 0.03-0.34 and verbalized calibration error (ECE) 0.53-0.94 across both splits; the gap does not close at the flagship tier. (2) The dominant failure is not hallucination: a full mention census plus a three-tier annotation of 360 sampled candidate

translated_title: 从不可靠到可用：分解大语言模型实体抽取中的失败模式与置信度信号——来自网络威胁情报的证据
translated_abstract: 对大型语言模型（LLM）从全文长文档中抽取信息的审计报告显示其严重不可靠，由此留下两个悬而未决的问题：失败究竟由什么构成，以及置信度信号能否将不可靠的输出转化为可用的输出。我们对两代新型低成本大语言模型（DeepSeek-V4-Flash、GLM-5.3-Flash）以及一个旗舰级对照模型（GPT-6.1-Sol）进行了预注册且完全冻结的评估，语料库为包含354个事件攻击行动的公开数据集（315份独立报告，630次模型-报告评估），并从三个方面进行评分：相对于金标准的抽取质量、置信度校准程度，以及对单句扰动的鲁棒性。研究得出三个发现。（1）不可靠性在各个模型层级均持续存在：在两个数据划分上，微观精确率仅为0.03-0.34，口头表述的校准误差（ECE）高达0.53-0.94；这一差距在旗舰级模型上也未消除。（2）主导性失败并非幻觉：通过一次完整的提及普查加上对360个抽样候选项的三层标注……
tldr: 该论文通过对新一代低成本与旗舰级大语言模型在354个网络威胁情报事件上的预注册冻结评估，发现实体抽取的不可靠性在所有模型层级均持续存在（精确率仅0.03-0.34且校准误差高达0.53-0.94），并揭示主导性失败并非幻觉，同时探索了置信度信号能否将不可靠输出转化为可用输出。
en_tdlr: Through a preregistered, fully frozen evaluation of new-generation low-cost and flagship-tier LLMs on 354 cyber threat intelligence campaigns, this paper shows that entity-extraction unreliability persists across all model tiers (micro precision 0.03-0.34, ECE 0.53-0.94), reveals that the dominant failure mode is not hallucination, and examines whether confidence signals can turn unreliable output into usable output.
